name: Nara
tagline: Great Buddha, deer and garden paths
summary: Nara’s eastern park circuit puts major Buddhist temples, a lantern-lined shrine and garden scenery within a rewarding walking day. Stay overnight to enjoy quieter mornings and add Naramachi.
seasonNote: Blossom and autumn foliage periods are busy. Summers are humid; winter brings quieter but colder walking.
arrival: Kintetsu-Nara is closest to the main park circuit. JR Nara has other useful rail links and is farther west of the park.
gettingAround: Walk the park cluster, using city buses for longer jumps. Keep east-park sights together and leave western temples for a separate excursion.
cashTip: Carry yen for smaller temple ticket desks, sweets shops and buses.
foodTip: Try freshly made yomogi mochi and a tofu or noodle meal. Use specific halal or vegetarian venues rather than assuming temple-town food is vegetarian.
buyTip: Browse Naramachi crafts and calligraphy supplies; edible souvenirs have short shelf lives.
baseArea: Kintetsu-Nara / Naramachi for walking; JR Nara for onward rail.

items.name: akordu
items.summary: Chef Hiroshi Kawashima’s innovative cooking with Basque training ("akordu" is Basque for "memories"), using Nara produce, a short walk from Todai-ji.
items.expect: A long tasting-menu meal. Deposits, cancellation fees and smart-casual dress codes are common at this level.
items.tip: Combine it with Todai-ji and Isuien Garden on the same afternoon.

items.bestTime: Lunch or dinner by reservation; check the current service days

whyVisit: Chef Hiroshi Kawashima’s innovative cooking with Basque training ("akordu" is Basque for "memories"), using Nara produce, a short walk from Todai-ji.
The MICHELIN Guide awards it Two MICHELIN Stars (excellent cooking), a rare level of recognition.
visitFlow: Book through the restaurant’s own site or official booking partner as soon as your dates are set.
Share allergies and dietary needs when booking; tasting menus are hard to change on the night.
Allow about three hours and plan a taxi or short walk back.
items.tradeoffs: Among the most expensive meals of a trip, and tables can sell out weeks or months ahead. Menus are set by the kitchen.
